title: Gerundio: liberales y conservadores en competencia

sections.content: An opening gerund states the goal behind an action (buscando reducir, intentando preservar) or two things a group did at once (formando alianzas y compitiendo). These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Los liberales, buscando reducir el poder de la Iglesia, defendían la venta de sus extensas propiedades.
items.english: Liberals, seeking to reduce the Church's power, advocated selling off its extensive properties.

items.spanish: Los conservadores, intentando preservar el orden social heredado de la colonia, defendían el papel tradicional de la Iglesia.
items.english: Conservatives, trying to preserve the social order inherited from the colony, defended the Church's traditional role.

items.spanish: Ambos bandos, formando alianzas cambiantes con caudillos regionales y compitiendo por el ejército, promovían visiones opuestas.
items.english: Both sides, forming shifting alliances with regional caudillos and competing for the army, promoted opposing visions.

items.spanish: Compitiendo por imponer su visión de manera permanente, ninguno de los dos bandos logró una victoria definitiva.
items.english: Competing to permanently impose its vision, neither side achieved a definitive victory.

sections.content: Buscando + infinitive and intentando + infinitive both state a goal, but intentando leans slightly more toward effort against resistance — useful when a text wants to suggest the goal wasn't easily achieved, as this whole paragraph does.
